# Packet — popol-vuh-012: The maiden Xquic and the skull in the calabash tree (fols. 15v–17r)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Va chi cute vꜩihoxic hun capoh, vmeal hun ahau, Cuchumaquic vbi.

¶2
Arecut ta xuta hun capoh, vmeal hun ahau, Cuchumaquic vbi vcahau, Xquic cut vbi ri capoh, ta xuta cut vꜩihoxic ri vvach che, ta chi ꜩihox chic rumal vcahau; chumaihah cut ta chi ꜩihoxic.

¶3
“Ma quinaoh vila ri che ca bixic? Quiꜩih quz vvach, ca cha ca nu tao,” xꜭha cut.

¶4
Cate xbec xa vtuquel, xapon cut chuxe che, tiquil chi Pucbal Chah, tiquil vi. “Hiiaa! Naquipe vvach vae che? Ma qui pa quz chi vachin va che? Ma qui cam tah, ma qui zach tah laquita xchin chup hunoc,” xꜭha cu ri capoh.

¶5
Ta xꜭhau cut ri bac ꜭo vla xol che: “Naquipa ca raih chire? Ri xa bac ri colocoxinac chu cabtac che,” xꜭha ri vholom Hunahpu, ta xꜭhauic chire ri capoh. “Ma ca raih?” xuꜭhaxic. “Ca nu raih,” xꜭha cut ri capoh. “Vꜩ bala; chaliquiba vloc ri a vi qui cab vila na,” xꜭha ri bac. “Ve,” xꜭha cu capoh; xuliquiba acan oc vvi qui cab chuvach bac.

¶6
Catecut chi piꜩ ca ban vchub bac, ta xpetic tacal cut pa cab capoh; ta xril cut vpa cab huzuc xunicoh; ma cu habi vchub bac pu cab.

¶7
“Xa retal mi xnu ya chave ri nu chub, nu caxah. Are ri nu holom mahabi ca chocon chi vi; xa bac, mahabi chi vchac. Xavi quehe vholom ve qui nim ahau; xa vtiohil vꜩ vi vvach. Arecut ta chi camic chuxibih chi rih vinac rumal vbaquil. Quehe cut xa vꜭahol, queheri vchub vcaxah vꜭoheic, ve vꜭahol ahau, ve puch vꜭahol naol, ahuchan; xma chi zach vi chi bec, chi ꜩacatahic; maui chupel, ma pu maixel vvach ahau, achih naol, ahuꜭhan; xa xchi canahic vmial, vꜭahol ta chuxoc. Quehe mi xnu ban chave. Cat acan cut chila chuvach vleu; maui ca camic. Cat oc pa ꜩih ta chuxoc,” xꜭha ri vholom Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu.

¶8
Xavi qui naoh ta xqui bano are vꜩih Huracan, Chipi Caculha, Raxa Caculha chiquech.

¶9
Quehe cu vꜩalihic chic capoh chi rochoch, quia pixab xbiyx chirech. Huzu cu xvinaquir ral chupam rumal ri xa chub; are cut qui vinaquiric Hunahpu, Xbalanque. Ta xopon cut chi rochoch ri capoh, xzacat cut vacaquib ic, ta xnauachil rumal vcahau, ri Cuchumaquic vbi vcahau.

¶10
Catepuch vnatahic capoh rumal vcahau, ta xil ri ral co chic. Ta xqui cuch cut qui naoh conohel ahauab Huncame, Vvcub Came ruc ri Cuchumaquic. “Are ri nu meal ꜭo chi ral, ix ahauab, xa vhoxbal,” xꜭha cu ri Cuchumaquic, ta xoponic cuꜭ ahauab. “Vꜩ bala; cha coto vchi ri; ta ma cu biyh, chi puz cut, chi naht chi be puzo vi.” “Vꜩ bala, alac ahauab,” xꜭha cut.

¶11
Catecut xuꜩonoh chirech vmeal: “Apa ahchoce ri aval co cha pam, at nu meal?” Xꜭha cut: “Mahabi val, lal nu cahau; mahabi achih vetaam vvach.” Xꜭha cut: “Vꜩ bala. Quiꜩih vi chi at hoxol. Chec, chi puzu, ix rahpop achih; chi cama vloc ri vꜭux chupan zel; chi qui cololeh ahauab vacamic,” xe vꜭhax cut ri Tucur.

¶12
E cahib ta xebec qui tiquem ri zel; ta xebec qui chelem ri capoh, cucaam ri Zaquitoc, puzbal re.

¶13
“Maui chuꜩinic quinicamizah, ix zamahel, rumal maui nu hoxbal ri ꜭo chi nu pam; xaqui xvinaquiric, xere xbe nu maihah ri vholom Hunhunahpu, ꜭo chi Pucbal Chah. Queque ta cut maui qui puz, ix zamahel,” xꜭha ri capoh ta xꜭhauic.

¶14
“Naquipa xchi ca coh vꜫexel ri iꜭux? Mi xbiyx vloc rumal a cahau: Chi cam vloc ri vꜭux; xchi qui ꜩololeh ahauab; xchi qui ꜩacuixtah, xchi qui hunam vachih vꜩaquic; chanim chi cama vloc pa zel, chi coloba; cahoc vꜭux chupan zel. Ma pa mi xoh vꜭhax vloc? Naquila cut xchi ca ya pa zel? Ca cah ta na bec, ma ta cat camic,” xeꜭha cu ri zamahel.

¶15
“Vꜩ bala. Maui quech ri ꜭux ta chuxoc; ruꜭ maui varal ivochoch chuxic; ma cu xa chi chih vinac chi camic; cate quiꜩih ivech ri quiꜩih hoxol, cate naipu vech Huncame, Vvcub Came; xa quic, xa holomax rech ta chuxoc; are chicut chuvach. Maui are ri ꜭux chi cat chuvach ta chuxoc. Chi coho ri vvach che,” ꜭha cut ri capoh.

¶16
Ꜫaꜫ cut vvaal ri che xelic, xcul pa zel. Catepuch xuvon rib, coloquic xuxic, vꜫexel vꜭux, ta iiꜩ chi cul vvaal cac che. Queheri quic vvaal che xelic vꜫexel vquiquel; ta xucolo chila ri quic chupan ri vvaal ꜫaꜫ che. Quehe curi quic rih xuxic, ꜫaꜫluhluh chic, colom chi pa zel, ta xcopcot ri che rumal capoh. Chuh Ꜫaꜫ Che chuꜭhaxic. Are curi quic xubinaah, rumal quic holomax chuchaxic.

¶17
“Chila cut quix locox vi; chuvach vleu ꜭo ivech chuxic,” xꜭha cut chique ri Tucur. “Vꜩ bala, at capoh. Xca beba; ca naba acan oc; xa ca bin apan oc; oh na ca yaix tah vva vꜫexevach a ꜭux chi qui vach ahauab,” xeꜭha cut ri zamahel.

¶18
Ta xopon cut chi qui vach ahauab; que zelevachin conohel. “Maui xuꜩinic?” xꜭha cut Huncame. “Mi xuꜩinic, ix ahauab; va na cu vꜭux xe ꜭo pa zel.” “Vꜩ bala; vila cut,” xꜭha cu ri Huncame. Ta xuchuieh cu acan oc; ta turur rih chi comah, ꜫaꜫluhluh rih chi quic. “Vꜩ chi luu vvach ꜫaꜫ; chi ya chuvi ꜫaꜫ,” xꜭha cut Huncame.

¶19
Catepuch xqui chaquih chuvi ꜫaꜫ, coc cut xqui na Xibalba; xe quiz yacatah vloc conohel, xe chique chuvi; quiꜩih chi quz xqui nao ri vzibel quic.

¶20
Arecut e chiquichoh vi canoc, ta xebe ri Tucur e uabai rech capoh; xu quia acan oc chi hul chuvi vleuh; xzalih chi cu cahoc ri vabanel. Quehe cut xe chacatah vi rahaual Xibalba ri rumal capoh; xe moyvachixic conohel.

## Establishment log (doubtful readings, letters chosen, supralinear words — the notes must say so)

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-012 (image 0040 from line 16, 0041, 0042, 0043 to line 29)

Read 2026-11-26 from source/pages/i0040 (from l.16, after `… Va cute xchi ca biyh roponic.`), all of i0041 and
i0042, and i0043 lines 1–29, in strips of about six lines at 1.2×, with 1.6–4× crops of every doubtful word,
checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 22690–22700, 22758–22775, 22850–22870, 22955–22990,
23054–23075, 23147–23157).
Start: `Va chi cute vꜩihoxic hun capoh …` (0040 l.16, Ximénez's indented heading). End: `… xe moyvachixic
conohel.` (0043 l.29). **The part ends sooner than planned, at the episode break**: 0043 l.30 begins a new
indented paragraph, `Arecut e ꜭo ri vchuch Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, ta xul ri ixoc Xquic …` (Xquic comes to the
grandmother), where Brasseur begins a new chapter (his `GAHPAH CHI TZIH`, not in the MS). Images 0044–0045 were not
needed. popol-vuh-013 should begin at **0043 l.30, `Arecut e ꜭo ri vchuch Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen …`** (MS
`Arecut egori vchuch hunbaꜩ | hunchoven taxulri ixoc xquic …`).

parts.json: popol-vuh-012 images set to 0040–0043 (last_image 43) and popol-vuh-013 to 0043–0047 (first_image 43,
cite `LoC images 0043–0047`), as 011's run did; pin re-run after the change.

Content: the heading (the story of a maiden, daughter of the lord Cuchumaquic); Xquic hears of the tree's fruit
and goes alone to Pucbal Chah; the skull in the tree speaks, spits into her hand; the speech on the head that
has no flesh and on sons as spittle and saliva; she conceives Hunahpu and Xbalanque; after six months her father
notices; the lords order her sacrificed and her heart brought in a bowl; the four Tucur (owl messengers) take her;
she persuades them, and the red sap of the tree (Chuh Ꜫaꜫ Che) is put in the bowl for her heart; the Tucur are
promised the earth; Huncame burns it, Xibalba stands entranced by the smell; the owls lead her up through the
hole; "thus the lords of Xibalba were defeated by a maiden; they were all blinded".

## Heading
The heading reads `Vachicute vꜩihoxic hun capoh / vmeal hun ahau cuchumaquic / vbi.` (2.5× crop: `Va chi cute`,
with Brasseur `Va chi cute`), not `Vae chi cate` as the task brief quoted it. Not in capitals; printed as its own
paragraph in ordinary case with a full stop.

## Folios
Counting as 004–011 did (0038 = 14v, 0040 = 15v): 0041 = 16r, 0042 = 16v, 0043 = 17r → `fols. 15v–17r`. The crop
of 0042 carries `16` at the top left (the folio doubt in QUESTIONS.md, 2026-11-24, again); the earlier count is kept.

## Paragraphs
Ximénez indents only the heading (0040 l.16), `Arecut ta xuta` (0040 l.19) and `Catepuch vnatahic` (0041 l.34);
the further paragraphs are cut at speech turns and episode joints, as 011 did within Ximénez's paragraphs.

## Letter rule used (002–011's rules, unchanged)
- g-shaped → ꜭ: `ꜭo vla` (B. qo ula), `ꜭo chi nu pam`, `ꜭo chi Pucbal Chah`, `ꜭo chi ral`, `xe ꜭo pa zel`,
  `ꜭo ivech` (all B. qo), `vꜭahol` ×4, `vꜭoheic`, `cuꜭ ahauab` (MS `cug`), `ruꜭ maui` (MS `rug`);
  gh → ꜭh: `xꜭha` (all), `xꜭhau`, `xꜭhauic` ×2, `xuꜭhaxic`, `xe vꜭhax`, `xoh vꜭhax`, `xeꜭha` ×2, `chuꜭhaxic`,
  `ahuꜭhan` (0041 l.14, MS `ahughan`, where l.11 has `ahuchan` with plain ch; both as written).
- q-shaped `qux` → `ꜭux` (009's rule): `vꜭux` ×5, `iꜭux`, `ri ꜭux` ×2, `a ꜭux`.
- q-shaped + u where Brasseur has g → ꜫ, u dropped: `vꜫexel` ×3 (MS `vquexel`, B. u gexel; the house table's
  vꜫexel), `vꜫexevach` (B. gexevach).
- tresillo → ꜫ: `Ꜫaꜫ cut vvaal` (0042 l.37), `ꜫaꜫ che` (l.44), `Chuh Ꜫaꜫ Che` (l.47), `ꜫaꜫluhluh` ×2 (0042 l.45,
  0043 l.15) — all B. cak 'red', but the MS has clear 3-shaped tresillos at 4×; `ꜫaꜫ` 'fire' ×4 (0043; B. gag).
- tz ligature → ꜩ: `vꜩihoxic` ×2, `ꜩihox`, `ꜩihoxic`, `quiꜩih` ×5, `vꜩih`, `ꜩih`, `Vꜩ bala` ×6, `vꜩ vi`,
  `vꜩ chi luu`, `chi piꜩ`, `iiꜩ`, `chi ꜩacatahic`, `vꜩalihic`, `xuꜩonoh`, `chuꜩinic`, `xuꜩinic` ×2,
  `xchi qui ꜩololeh`, `ꜩacuixtah`, `vꜩaquic`, `Hunbaꜩ` (013's first line only).
- z (plain ʒ) kept as z: `zach tah`, `zach vi`, `zel` throughout, `zamahel` throughout, `Zaquitoc`, `puz`, `puzu`,
  `puzo`, `puzbal`, `huzuc`, `Huzu`, `xzacat`, `zelevachin`, `vzibel` (B. u zibel), `xzalih`.
- q-shaped + vowel u kept as written where Brasseur has g: `quz` ×3 (0040 l.26, l.31; 0043 l.21; B. guz) — as 010's
  `Quzquz` (B. guzguz); presumably q'us 'sweet' (the drafter decides).
- plain c kept where Brasseur has g, q or k: `chu cabtac che` (B. gab), `qui cab` ×2, `pa cab`, `vpa cab`, `pu cab`
  (B. gab), `cac che` (0042 l.41, B. cak; plain c, where l.37 and l.44 have tresillos), `co chic` (0041 l.35,
  B. qo chic; 2.2× crop, plain c), `co cha pam` (B. qo ch'a pam), `cha coto` (B. qoto), `ruc ri Cuchumaquic`
  (B. ruq), `chi cama vloc` ×2 (B. qama), `chi cat chuvach` (B. qat), `cate`/`Catecut`/`Catepuch` (B. Qate…),
  `chi ca coh`, `ca ya` (B. ka), `capoh` throughout (B. gapoh), `Caculha` (B. Cakulha).
